---
title: "Find your practice outputs"
---


After the practice command completes, open `results/example/`.

| File | What to check |
|---|---|
| `tables/alpha-diversity.tsv` | One row per sample with totals, observed features, and Shannon |
| `tables/relative-abundance.tsv` | Original feature proportions for every sample |
| `tables/composition-display.tsv` | Top eight features and pooled Other |
| `tables/group-summary.tsv` | Group summaries |
| `figures/` | Three PNGs for the guide and report |

All 24 samples should appear in the diversity table. Select A01 for the independent check.
